Official valgardena.it ski-pass page: 'Ski pass Val Gardena/Seiser Alm — 79 lifts + 181 km ski runs' (body text says 79 lifts and 175 km). Colour split remains from the earlier skiresort.com search summary.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Ski schools and rental shops operate in all three villages; other features not on file

character: Dolomite valley in South Tyrol with three villages (Ortisei, Santa Cristina and Selva) on the Sella Ronda circuit and the wider Dolomiti Superski network. Most home terrain is easy to intermediate; the Saslong World Cup downhill runs above Santa Cristina (reference).
learning: About 28% of the 181 km are easy runs (skiresort.info via search). Ski schools in each village (reference); the Seiser Alm/Alpe di Siusi area on the local pass is known for gentle terrain (reference) — confirm.
